capability.summary: Measure the base64 length of a generated QR image
capability.description: Generates a QR image in memory from one data string using qrcode defaults, saves it to a byte buffer, base64-encodes those bytes, and returns only the encoded byte-count alongside the original data.
capability.problem_space: Checking whether default QR generation succeeds and measuring the resulting base64 payload length without returning the image payload.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one data string; output: JSON echoing data and reporting png_base64_len as the length of the base64-encoded in-memory image bytes.
accepted_inputs: a text string whose encoded content fits within a QR code supported by qrcode.make defaults
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.qrcode_generate", data as the original input string, and png_base64_len as the integer length of the base64-encoded in-memory image bytes; no image payload is included. A caught QR-capacity, image-generation, serialization, or base64 exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.qrcode_generate", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: does not return, write, or expose the QR image or its base64 data despite the image artifact declaration
png_base64_len is only a byte-count of the encoded base64 payload, not the payload itself
uses qrcode.make and image-save defaults with no caller control over version, error correction, box size, border, colors, style, or output path
echoes the complete input data in the output, which may be unsuitable for sensitive payloads
oversized data and image-generation or serialization failures use the wrapper's error envelope

output_contract.description: Original data and the base64-encoded image length only; no QR image or base64 payload is included.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.
